The stylesheet argues with itself in writing — qss.py:303-315 is a design rationale, not a comment. That is how a system stays coherent under many hands.

directions.name: Editorial — type-led, larger, more air
directions.thesis: Treat the panel as a column of set text with one hairline: the hierarchy is size and weight, colour is a single accent on the artist's own turn, and the pane earns its height with air rather than chrome.
changes: Scale 12 / 13 / 17 / 22 (body 13, title 17, display 22); wordmark back to weight 400 at BRAND 0.286em (tokens.py:396-405 keeps the reasoning); labels 12/500, captions 12/400 — three sizes on the resting face
Between speakers SPACE_32 32, within 12 (message_formatter.py:69-70); rail top SPACE_LG 24 as the standard density; GUTTER 32
SIGNAL only on the YOU turn rule and the focus ring; SYNAPSE turns carry no rule, only the 16px indent; SEND becomes a type verb (DsVerb) not a filled knockout
Flat PANEL ground, radius 0 everywhere, no card border — the consent card is a titled block set apart by 24px above and below
directions.tradeoff: Costs vertical budget the pane does not have: fewer visible turns in 380px and direct pressure on D1's 400px floor and BC-5's transcript share (awaits A1/A2). Reads as a document, which the composer and gate card must then live inside without ever looking like a form.

directions.name: Instrument — denser, tabular, receipt-first
directions.thesis: The panel is a meter, not a magazine: everything except the conversation body is mono, two sizes, columns aligned, and each mutating turn ends in a right-aligned receipt column that the eye can scan like a ledger.
changes: Two sizes: 11 mono for all chrome (rail, verbs, labels, receipts), 12 sans for conversation body; weights 400/600 only; TRACKING DATA 0.03 everywhere in mono
Rail collapses to one row: mark · SYNAPSE · state sentence · Connect · Check · ⋯ — the second row's height goes to the transcript
Turn tail = one mono line right-aligned in TEXT_TERTIARY: '14 · 2:14 PM · mcp 4/4' (this is C2a + C4 + C5 ratified together, scroll-content placement per C2b's 0px option)
Tight density as the default; radius 0; no gradient; DsCard as a ruled table (header rule, body, footer rule) with no side borders
directions.tradeoff: Reads as a terminal, and the voice guide asks for a senior artist at your shoulder, not a console. Mono at 11px on a 280px pane is at the edge of legibility on a 4K host at 100% scaling; and it commits the team to shipping the receipt (C2a) rather than ruling it separately.

directions.name: Host-native — recede into Houdini
directions.thesis: The panel should look like a Houdini pane that happens to talk: inherit the host font, the host greys and the host's own tab marker as the single accent, so the only brand on screen is the wordmark.
changes: Drop the bundled Space Grotesk / Space Mono; fontload keeps the host QApplication font and QFontDatabase FixedFont for mono (the build_mismatch branch, fontload.py:106-115 per map, becomes the only branch)

One accent: HOUDINI_TAB_YELLOW from hou.qt.getColor('PaneTabMarker') (tokens.py:255-256) on the active tab underline, the focus ring and the SEND fill; SIGNAL, SIGNAL_DEEP, WARM, CONIFEROUS retired from chrome — this settles B1 by making the host marker the accent rather than the exception
Radii = Houdini's own 2px; no gradient; PANEL/GROUND already host-seeded (tokens.py:123-158) so nothing else moves
Transcript keeps _MONO = Consolas (message_formatter.py:75) as the deliberate choice it already claims to be
directions.tradeoff: Loses the identity the v9 comp built (Space Grotesk wordmark, the blue/warm pair) and the panel becomes indistinguishable from a native pane until it speaks; a yellow accent on a warm-grey host is lower-contrast than SIGNAL (B1's 139px of yellow was the complaint) so the accent gets used less, not more.
